name: SPT
summary: South Pole millimeter-wave telescope using CMB, galaxy-cluster and lensing measurements to study dark-matter structure; SPT-3G also studies time-varying birefringence from ultralight axions.
detection_principle: An off-axis reflecting telescope and cryogenic multifrequency detectors measure CMB temperature and polarization, reconstruct lensing and test time-dependent polarization angles.

results.summary: SPT-3G tests axion-like dark matter through time-varying cosmic birefringence.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
